sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Simple sequencing expressions such as *reggel*, délben, délután and *este* help organise a routine.

items.english: I get up in the morning.
I go to bed in the evening.

sections.content: felkelek and lefekszem bookend your day the same way reggel and este do — getting up and going to bed are, appropriately, opposite actions described with opposite prefixes. Pair the vocab with the concept: fel- (up) with waking, le- (down) with sleeping, and neither verb will feel random.
